name: 53528 · Cross Plains, WI
findings: ZIP 53528 (Cross Plains) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53528 (Cross Plains) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
